<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@400;500;700&family=Roboto:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,700;1,400;1,500;1,700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
<style>
/* ============================================================
   zelda-hyrule-ui style · built strictly from skill/SKILL.md
   Real assets (Hylia Serif + all SVG paths) reused verbatim from
   the showcase calendar's package-exported sources. No approximations.
   Bilingual (EN / demo) — single source, switch top-right or ?lang=zh.
   Design: Zelda BOTW UI Kit by Hunter Paramore (CC BY 4.0)
   ============================================================ */

@font-face {
  font-family: 'Hylia Serif';
  src: url(data:font/ttf;base64,) format('truetype');
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}

:root {
  --zelda-dark-bg: #66645D;
  --bg-sheikah-panel: #0a1628;
  --bg-card: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  --text-main: #E9E1D1;
  --text-muted: rgba(233, 225, 209, 0.6);
  --text-yellow: #E2D146;
  --zelda-tan: #E2DED3;
  --sheikah-blue: #3CD3FC;
  --sheikah-glow: #4FC0FF;
  --effect-orange: #FCC413;
  --heart-red: #F1362F;
  --orb-blue: #4FC0FF;
  --k-main: #FFD700;
  --k-side: #3CD3FC;
  --k-shrine: #3CD3FC;
  --k-memory: #FCC413;
  --k-stamina: #13FF59;
  --k-rupee: #6FD49C;
  --border-inner: rgba(226, 222, 211, 0.3);
  --font-title: 'Hylia Serif', 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif;
  --font-body: 'Roboto', -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

body {
  background: var(--zelda-dark-bg);
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.5;
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: clamp(12px, 3vw, 40px);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sheikah-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }
html[lang="zh"] body { font-style: normal; }

/* ============ SheikahBackground darkBlue + Scanlines ============ */
.slate {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 1040px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: var(--bg-sheikah-panel);
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}
.slate::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 3px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.4);
  border-radius: 6px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 5;
}
.scanlines {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  mix-blend-mode: overlay;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 1px, rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.03) 1px, rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.03) 2px);
  filter: blur(0.5px);
  animation: scan-move 8s linear infinite;
  z-index: 4;
}
@keyframes scan-move { 0% { background-position: 0 0; } 100% { background-position: 0 200px; } }

.eye-watermark {
  position: absolute;
  right: -120px; bottom: -140px;
  width: 540px;
  aspect-ratio: 380 / 350;
  --fill-0: #3CD3FC;
  opacity: 0.05;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}
.inner { position: relative; z-index: 1; padding: clamp(20px, 3.5vw, 44px); }

/* ============ Language switch ============ */
.lang-switch { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px; font-style: normal; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.lang-switch button { font: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-style: normal; color: var(--text-muted); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4); border: 1px solid var(--border-inner); border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 10px; cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: 0.04em; transition: color 0.2s var(--ease), border-color 0.2s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease); }
.lang-switch button:hover { color: var(--text-main); }
.lang-switch button.active { color: var(--sheikah-blue); border-color: var(--sheikah-blue); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.4); }

/* ============ Header ============ */
header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.eye-badge { width: 62px; aspect-ratio: 380 / 350; flex: none; --fill-0: var(--sheikah-blue); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(79, 192, 255, 0.6)); }
.masthead h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;
  font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 40px);
  color: var(--zelda-tan);
  letter-spacing: 0.04em; line-height: 1.1;
  text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.35);
}
.masthead .sub { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin-top: 4px; }
.masthead .sub b { color: var(--sheikah-blue); font-weight: 500; font-style: normal; }

/* ============ HUD ============ */
.hud { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-style: normal; }
.hud-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.hud-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.hearts { display: flex; gap: 3px; flex-wrap: wrap; max-width: 200px; justify-content: center; }
.hearts svg { width: 19px; height: 15px; filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)); }
.hcount { font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-size: 17px; color: var(--zelda-tan); }
.stamina-wheel { position: relative; width: 42px; height: 42px; }
.stamina-wheel svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.stamina-wheel .fill {
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(19, 255, 89, 0.6));
  -webkit-mask-image: conic-gradient(from -90deg, black var(--ang), transparent var(--ang));
  mask-image: conic-gradient(from -90deg, black var(--ang), transparent var(--ang));
}
.orbs { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.orbs .orb-ico { width: 20px; height: 20px; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(79, 192, 255, 0.8)); }
.orbs .amount { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; color: #FFFDE4; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); display: inline-block; }
.amount.bump { animation: rupee-bump 0.45s var(--ease); }
@keyframes rupee-bump { 0% { transform: scale(1); } 35% { transform: scale(1.3); color: var(--orb-blue); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }
.hud-label { font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; }

/* ============ Orb → Heart progress strip ============ */
.progress {
  position: relative;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  background: var(--bg-card); border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 13px 18px; margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.progress::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--border-inner); border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; }
.progress .pstat { font-style: normal; }
.progress .pstat .n { font-family: var(--font-title); font-size: 22px; color: var(--zelda-tan); line-height: 1; }
.progress .pstat .n.blue { color: var(--sheikah-blue); text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(60,211,252,0.5); }
.progress .pstat .l { display: block; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 3px; }
.progress .psep { width: 1px; align-self: stretch; background: var(--border-inner); }
.progress .ptrack { flex: 1; min-width: 160px; }
.progress .ptrack .bar { position: relative; height: 9px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden; }
.progress .ptrack .bar::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border-inner); border-radius: 5px; }
.progress .ptrack .fill { height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--sheikah-blue), var(--orb-blue)); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(60,211,252,0.6); transition: width 0.5s var(--ease); }
.progress .ptrack .cap { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 5px; font-style: normal; text-align: right; }

/* ============ Habit roster ============ */
.roster { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
.habit {
  position: relative;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 15px 16px 14px;
}
.habit::after {
  content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-inner); border-radius: 4px;
  pointer-events: none; transition: border-color 0.3s var(--ease);
}
.habit:hover::after { border-color: rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.4); }
.habit-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.habit-head .hico { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; }
.habit-head .hname { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-size: 17px; color: var(--zelda-tan); letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1.15; }
.habit-head .hdel { flex: none; background: none; border: none; color: var(--text-muted); font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-style: normal; cursor: pointer; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; line-height: 1; }
.habit-head .hdel:hover { color: var(--heart-red); }
.streak { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 5px; font-style: normal; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.streak .sv { font-family: var(--font-title); font-size: 18px; color: var(--effect-orange); text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.55); line-height: 1; }
.streak .sl { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

/* monthly heatmap */
.heat { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); gap: 4px; }
.heat .hc {
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(226, 222, 211, 0.12);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: box-shadow 0.18s var(--ease), background 0.18s var(--ease), transform 0.08s var(--ease);
  position: relative;
}
.heat .hc:hover { border-color: var(--sheikah-blue); }
.heat .hc.done {
  background: var(--hk, var(--sheikah-blue));
  border-color: transparent;
  box-shadow: 0 0 7px 1px var(--hkglow, rgba(60,211,252,0.6));
}
.heat .hc.done.pop { animation: hc-pop 0.32s var(--ease); }
@keyframes hc-pop { 0% { transform: scale(0.6); } 60% { transform: scale(1.18); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }
.heat .hc.today { outline: 2px solid var(--zelda-tan); outline-offset: 1px; }
.heat .hc.future { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.25); border-color: rgba(226,222,211,0.06); cursor: default; pointer-events: none; }
.heat .hc.pad { background: none; border: none; cursor: default; pointer-events: none; }
.heat-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-style: normal; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.06em; margin-top: 9px; }
.heat-foot .rate { color: var(--text-main); }

/* ============ Add-habit form ============ */
.add { position: relative; background: var(--bg-card); border-radius: 4px; padding: 15px 18px; margin-top: 18px; }
.add::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--border-inner); border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; }
.add h3 { font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; font-size: 15px; color: var(--zelda-tan); letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.add-kinds { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 11px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.add-kind { position: relative; }
.add-kind input { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.add-kind span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 10.5px; font-style: normal; color: var(--text-muted); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: border-color 0.2s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease); }
.add-kind span svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
.add-kind input:checked + span { border-color: var(--sheikah-blue); color: var(--text-main); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(79,192,255,0.45); }
.add-kind input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid var(--sheikah-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }
.add-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.add-row input[type="text"] { flex: 1; min-width: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border: 1px solid var(--border-inner); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--text-main); font: inherit; font-size: 13px; padding: 8px 10px; }
.add-row input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); }
.add-add { flex: none; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a14; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #7FE0FF, var(--sheikah-blue)); border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 18px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(60,211,252,0.45); }
.add-add:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(60,211,252,0.8); }

/* ============ Oracle dialog ============ */
.dialog { position: relative; max-width: 820px; margin: 26px auto 6px; padding: 30px 70px 34px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; min-height: 130px; }
.dialog .bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
.dialog .speaker { position: relative; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-main); text-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); margin-bottom: 3px; }
.dialog .content { position: relative; font-size: clamp(14px, 2.1vw, 19px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; }
.dialog .content .hl { color: var(--effect-orange); }

footer { text-align: center; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
footer .ftr-hint { color: var(--text-yellow); letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
footer a { color: var(--sheikah-blue); text-decoration: none; }
footer a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

/* ============ Heart Container toast ============ */
.qtoast { position: fixed; top: 26px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 60; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.78); border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 22px; pointer-events: none; max-width: calc(100vw - 32px); animation: toast-in 2.6s var(--ease) forwards; }
.qtoast[hidden] { display: none; }
.qtoast::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px; border: 1px solid rgba(241, 54, 47, 0.5); border-radius: 2px; }
.qtoast svg { width: 22px; height: 18px; flex: none; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(241,54,47,0.8)); }
.qtoast .tt { font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: #FF8A80; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(241,54,47,0.5); white-space: nowrap; }
.qtoast .ts { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text-muted); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
@keyframes toast-in { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-8px); } 7%,80% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-6px); } }

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .eye-badge { width: 44px; }
  header { gap: 14px; }
  .hud { gap: 16px; margin-left: 0; }
  .roster { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .dialog { padding: 22px 28px 30px; min-height: 104px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .scanlines, .qtoast, .amount.bump, .heat .hc.pop { animation: none; }
}
</style>
</head>

  try { const s = localStorage.getItem('shrine-tracker-lang'); if (s === 'zh' || s === 'en') return s; } catch (e) {}
  return (navigator.language || '').toLowerCase().startsWith('zh') ? 'zh' : 'en';
}
let lang = pickLang();
const T = () => I18N[lang];
const uid = () => Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6);

/* orb icon = real Sheikah shrine badge, recolored blue */
const ORB = questSvg('shrine');

const STORE = 'daily-shrine-tracker-v1';
function seed() { return T().seed.map(h => ({ id: uid(), name: h.name, kind: h.kind, days: h.days.slice() })); }
function load() {
  try {
    const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE) || 'null');
    if (Array.isArray(s) && s.every(h => h && typeof h.name === 'string' && Array.isArray(h.days))) return s;
  } catch (e) {}
  return seed();
}
let habits = load();
const save = () => { try { localStorage.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify(habits)); } catch (e) {} };

const totalChecks = () => habits.reduce((a, h) => a + h.days.filter(d => d <= TODAY).length, 0);
const heartCount = () => Math.floor(totalChecks() / ORBS_PER_HEART);
function streakOf(h) {
  let s = 0, start = h.days.includes(TODAY) ? TODAY : TODAY - 1;
  for (let d = start; d >= 1 && h.days.includes(d); d--) s++;
  return s;
}
function monthRate() {
  const possible = habits.length * TODAY;
  return possible ? Math.round((totalChecks() / possible) * 100) : 0;
}

/* ---- HUD ---- */
const orbEl = document.getElementById('orb-amount');
function renderHud(bump) {
  const hearts = heartCount();
  const heartsEl = document.getElementById('hearts');
  if (hearts <= 12) {
    let h = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < hearts; i++) h += heartSvg('filled');
    heartsEl.innerHTML = h || heartSvg('empty');
  } else {
    heartsEl.innerHTML = heartSvg('filled') + `<span class="hcount">×${hearts}</span>`;
  }
  const rate = monthRate();
  document.getElementById('stamina').style.setProperty('--ang', (rate / 100 * 360) + 'deg');
  document.getElementById('stamina').innerHTML = staminaTrack + staminaFill(rate >= 100 ? '#FFE465' : '#13FF59');
  document.getElementById('lbl-rate').textContent = rate + T().rateSuffix;
  document.getElementById('orb-ico').innerHTML = ORB;
  const orbs = totalChecks();
  orbEl.textContent = orbs.toLocaleString(T().locale);
  if (bump) { orbEl.classList.remove('bump'); void orbEl.offsetWidth; orbEl.classList.add('bump'); }

  const into = orbs % ORBS_PER_HEART, pct = (into / ORBS_PER_HEART) * 100;
  const longest = habits.reduce((m, h) => Math.max(m, streakOf(h)), 0);
  document.getElementById('progress').innerHTML = `
    <div class="pstat"><span class="n blue">${heartCount()}</span><span class="l">${T().hearts}</span></div>
    <div class="psep"></div>
    <div class="pstat"><span class="n">${longest}</span><span class="l">${T().longestStreak} · ${T().daysWord}</span></div>
    <div class="psep"></div>
    <div class="ptrack">
      <div class="bar"><div class="fill" style="width:${pct}%"></div></div>
      <div class="cap">${T().nextHeartCap(into, ORBS_PER_HEART)}</div>
    </div>`;

  const oracle = document.getElementById('oracle-line');
  oracle.innerHTML = hearts > 0 ? T().oracleMid(hearts) : T().oracleStart;
}

/* ---- roster ---- */
const roster = document.getElementById('roster');
const PAD = (FIRST_WD - 1);
function habitCard(h) {
  const done = new Set(h.days);
  let cells = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < PAD; i++) cells += '<div class="hc pad"></div>';
  for (let d = 1; d <= DAYS; d++) {
    const cls = ['hc'];
    if (d > TODAY) cls.push('future');
    else if (done.has(d)) cls.push('done');
    if (d === TODAY) cls.push('today');
    const style = done.has(d) ? ` style="--hk:${KIND_COLOR[h.kind]};--hkglow:${KIND_GLOW[h.kind]}"` : '';
    cells += `<div class="${cls.join(' ')}"${d <= TODAY ? ` role="button" tabindex="0" data-h="${h.id}" data-d="${d}" aria-label="Day ${d}${done.has(d) ? ' done' : ''}"` : ''}${style}></div>`;
  }
  const rate = Math.round((h.days.filter(d => d <= TODAY).length / TODAY) * 100);
  return `
    <div class="habit" data-id="${h.id}">
      <div class="habit-head">
        <span class="hico" style="color:${KIND_COLOR[h.kind]}">${ICON[h.kind]}</span>
        <span class="hname">${esc(h.name)}</span>
        <button class="hdel" data-del="${h.id}" aria-label="${esc(T().delLabel(h.name))}">✕</button>
      </div>
      <div class="streak"><span class="sv">${streakOf(h)}</span><span class="sl">${T().streakLabel}</span></div>
      <div class="heat">${cells}</div>
      <div class="heat-foot"><span>${T().weekday.join('   ')}</span><span class="rate">${T().rateFoot(rate)}</span></div>
    </div>`;
}
function renderRoster() {
  roster.innerHTML = habits.length
    ? habits.map(habitCard).join('')
    : `<div class="habit" style="grid-column:1/-1"><div class="habit-head"><span class="hname">${T().noHabits}</span></div><div class="streak"><span class="sl">${T().noHabitsSub}</span></div></div>`;
}
function render(bump) { renderRoster(); renderHud(bump); save(); }

/* ---- toast ---- */
const toast = document.getElementById('qtoast');
let toastTimer = null;
function showHeartToast() {
  toast.innerHTML = `${heartSvg('filled')}<span class="tt">${esc(T().heartGet)}</span><span class="ts">${esc(T().heartGetSub(heartCount()))}</span>`;
  toast.hidden = false;
  toast.style.animation = 'none'; void toast.offsetWidth; toast.style.animation = '';
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(() => { toast.hidden = true; }, 2600);
}

const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
function toggleDay(hid, d) {
  const h = habits.find(x => x.id === hid);
  if (!h || d > TODAY) return;
  const beforeHearts = heartCount();
  const i = h.days.indexOf(d);
  const adding = i < 0;
  if (adding) h.days.push(d); else h.days.splice(i, 1);
  render(adding);
  if (adding && !reduceMotion) {
    const cell = roster.querySelector(`[data-h="${hid}"][data-d="${d}"]`);
    if (cell) { cell.classList.add('pop'); }
  }
  if (heartCount() > beforeHearts) showHeartToast();
}

/* ---- static chrome ---- */
function applyStatic() {
  const t = T();
  document.documentElement.lang = lang;
  document.title = t.docTitle;
  document.getElementById('mast-title').textContent = t.title;
  document.getElementById('mast-sub').innerHTML = `${t.subPlain}<b>${t.subBold}</b>`;
  document.getElementById('lbl-hearts').textContent = t.hearts;
  document.getElementById('lbl-orbs').textContent = t.orbs;
  document.getElementById('add-h').textContent = t.addH;
  const fn = document.getElementById('f-name'); fn.placeholder = t.namePlaceholder; fn.setAttribute('aria-label', t.nameLabel);
  document.getElementById('add-btn').textContent = t.consecrate;
  document.getElementById('add-kinds').setAttribute('aria-label', t.habitType);
  document.getElementById('add-kinds').innerHTML = KIND_ORDER.map((k, i) =>
    `<label class="add-kind"><input type="radio" name="hk" value="${k}"${i === 0 ? ' checked' : ''} /><span style="color:${KIND_COLOR[k]}">${ICON[k]}</span><span>${t.kinds[k]}</span></label>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('oracle-speaker').textContent = t.speaker;
  document.getElementById('footer').innerHTML = `<span class="ftr-hint">${t.footerHint}</span><br/>${t.footerCredit}`;
  document.querySelectorAll('#lang-switch button').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.lang === lang));
}

function switchLang(l) {
  if (l === lang) return;
  lang = l;
  try { localStorage.setItem('shrine-tracker-lang', l); } catch (e) {}
  applyStatic();
  render(false);
}

/* ---- wiring ---- */
function cellFromEvent(t) { return t && t.closest ? t.closest('[data-h]') : null; }
document.addEventListener('click', ev => {
  const ls = ev.target.closest('[data-lang]');
  if (ls) { switchLang(ls.dataset.lang); return; }
  const del = ev.target.closest('[data-del]');
  if (del) { habits = habits.filter(h => h.id !== del.dataset.del); render(); return; }
  const cell = cellFromEvent(ev.target);
  if (cell) { toggleDay(cell.dataset.h, +cell.dataset.d); }
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', ev => {
  if (ev.key !== 'Enter' && ev.key !== ' ') return;
  const cell = cellFromEvent(ev.target);
  if (cell) { ev.preventDefault(); toggleDay(cell.dataset.h, +cell.dataset.d); }
});

document.getElementById('add-form').addEventListener('submit', ev => {
  ev.preventDefault();
  const name = document.getElementById('f-name').value.trim();
  if (!name) return;
  const kind = document.querySelector('#add-kinds input:checked').value;
  habits.push({ id: uid(), name, kind, days: [] });
  ev.target.reset();
  applyStatic(); /* restore default checked kind */
  render();
  document.getElementById('f-name').focus();
});

applyStatic();
render();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>

<meta name="twitter:description" content="Turn exam revision into a BOTW boss fight. demodemodemo Boss. " />
<meta name="twitter:image" content="https://chaos-xxl.github.io/zelda-hyrule-ui/showcase/finals-boss-rush-og.png" />
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@400;500;700&family=Roboto:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,700;1,400;1,500;1,700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
<style>
/* ============================================================
   zelda-hyrule-ui style · built strictly from skill/SKILL.md
   Real assets (Hylia Serif + all SVG paths) reused verbatim from
   the showcase calendar's package-exported sources. No approximations.
   Bilingual (EN / demo) — single source, switch top-right or ?lang=zh.
   Design: Zelda BOTW UI Kit by Hunter Paramore (CC BY 4.0)
   ============================================================ */

@font-face {
  font-family: 'Hylia Serif';
  src: url(data:font/ttf;base64,) format('truetype');
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}

:root {
  --zelda-dark-bg: #66645D;
  --bg-sheikah-panel: #0a1628;
  --bg-card: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  --bg-slot: rgba(60, 58, 52, 0.35);
  --text-main: #E9E1D1;
  --text-muted: rgba(233, 225, 209, 0.6);
  --text-yellow: #E2D146;
  --text-red: #F15050;
  --text-green: #6FD49C;
  --zelda-tan: #E2DED3;
  --sheikah-blue: #3CD3FC;
  --sheikah-glow: #4FC0FF;
  --effect-orange: #FCC413;
  --boss-red: #F1362F;
  --boss-red-glow: #FF6A5E;
  --quest-main: #FFD700;
  --quest-main-glow: #FFEA2E;
  --border-inner: rgba(226, 222, 211, 0.3);
  --font-title: 'Hylia Serif', 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif;
  --font-body: 'Roboto', -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

body {
  background: var(--zelda-dark-bg);
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.5;
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: clamp(12px, 3vw, 40px);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sheikah-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }
/* demo (demo#4 demo；demo)  */
html[lang="zh"] body { font-style: normal; }

/* ============ SheikahBackground darkBlue + Scanlines ============ */
.slate {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 1100px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: var(--bg-sheikah-panel);
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}
.slate::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 3px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.4);
  border-radius: 6px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 5;
}
.scanlines {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  mix-blend-mode: overlay;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 1px, rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.03) 1px, rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.03) 2px);
  filter: blur(0.5px);
  animation: scan-move 8s linear infinite;
  z-index: 4;
}
@keyframes scan-move { 0% { background-position: 0 0; } 100% { background-position: 0 200px; } }

.eye-watermark {
  position: absolute;
  right: -120px; bottom: -140px;
  width: 560px;
  aspect-ratio: 380 / 350;
  --fill-0: #3CD3FC;
  opacity: 0.05;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}
.inner { position: relative; z-index: 1; padding: clamp(20px, 3.5vw, 44px); }

/* ============ Language switch ============ */
.lang-switch { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px; font-style: normal; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.lang-switch button { font: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-style: normal; color: var(--text-muted); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4); border: 1px solid var(--border-inner); border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 10px; cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: 0.04em; transition: color 0.2s var(--ease), border-color 0.2s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease); }
.lang-switch button:hover { color: var(--text-main); }
.lang-switch button.active { color: var(--sheikah-blue); border-color: var(--sheikah-blue); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.4); }

/* ============ Header ============ */
header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.eye-badge {
  width: 62px;
  aspect-ratio: 380 / 350;
  flex: none;
  --fill-0: var(--sheikah-blue);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(79, 192, 255, 0.6));
}
.masthead h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 40px);
  color: var(--zelda-tan);
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  line-height: 1.1;
  text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.35);
}
.masthead .sub { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin-top: 4px; }
.masthead .sub b { color: var(--text-red); font-weight: 500; font-style: normal; }

/* ============ HUD ============ */
.hud { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-style: normal; }
.hud-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.hud-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.hearts { display: flex; gap: 3px; }
.hearts svg { width: 21px; height: 17px; filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)); }
.stamina-wheel { position: relative; width: 42px; height: 42px; }
.stamina-wheel svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.stamina-wheel .fill {
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(19, 255, 89, 0.6));
  -webkit-mask-image: conic-gradient(from -90deg, black var(--ang), transparent var(--ang));
  mask-image: conic-gradient(from -90deg, black var(--ang), transparent var(--ang));
}
.hud-rupee svg { width: 14px; height: 26px; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.55)); }
.hud-rupee .amount { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; color: #FFFDE4; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); letter-spacing: 0.03em; display: inline-block; }
.amount.bump { animation: rupee-bump 0.45s var(--ease); }
@keyframes rupee-bump { 0% { transform: scale(1); } 35% { transform: scale(1.3); color: #FFE465; } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }
.hud-label { font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; }

/* ============ Campaign status strip ============ */
.campaign {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 13px 18px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.campaign::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--border-inner); border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; }
.camp-stat { font-style: normal; }
.camp-stat .n { font-family: var(--font-title); font-size: 22px; color: var(--zelda-tan); line-height: 1; }
.camp-stat .n.red { color: var(--boss-red); text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(241, 54, 47, 0.5); }
.camp-stat .n.gold { color: var(--effect-orange); text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.5); }
.camp-stat .l { display: block; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 3px; }
.camp-sep { width: 1px; align-self: stretch; background: var(--border-inner); }
.camp-bar { flex: 1; min-width: 160px; }
.camp-bar .track { position: relative; height: 9px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden; }
.camp-bar .track::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border-inner); border-radius: 5px; }
.camp-bar .fill { height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #13FF59, #6FD49C); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(19, 255, 89, 0.6); transition: width 0.5s var(--ease); }
.camp-bar .cap { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin-top: 5px; font-style: normal; text-align: right; }

/* ============ Finale banner ============ */
.finale {
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(252,196,19,0.16), rgba(0,0,0,0.5));
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 18px 20px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.finale::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px; border: 1px solid rgba(252,196,19,0.6); border-radius: 4px; pointer-events: none; }
.finale[hidden] { display: none; }
.finale h2 { font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(22px, 4vw, 32px); color: var(--effect-orange); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.6); }
.finale p { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-main); margin-top: 6px; }

/* ============ Boss roster ============ */
.roster { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
.boss {
  position: relative;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 16px 16px 14px;
  transition: box-shadow 0.3s var(--ease), transform 0.1s var(--ease);
}
.boss::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 3px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(241, 54, 47, 0.4);
  border-radius: 4px;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: border-color 0.3s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.3s var(--ease);
}
.boss:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(241, 54, 47, 0.25); }
.boss.hit { animation: boss-shake 0.32s var(--ease); }
@keyframes boss-shake { 0%,100% { transform: translateX(0); } 20% { transform: translateX(-5px); } 45% { transform: translateX(4px); } 70% { transform: translateX(-2px); } }

.boss-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.boss-name { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.boss-name .nm { font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; font-size: 19px; color: var(--boss-red); letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(241, 54, 47, 0.45); line-height: 1.15; }
.boss-name .ep { display: block; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 3px; font-style: normal; }
.boss-del { flex: none; background: none; border: none; color: var(--text-muted); font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-style: normal; cursor: pointer; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; line-height: 1; }
.boss-del:hover { color: var(--text-red); }

.boss-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-style: normal; margin-bottom: 9px; gap: 8px; }
.countdown { font-size: 12px; color: var(--sheikah-blue); letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.countdown.soon { color: var(--effect-orange); }
.countdown.overdue { color: var(--boss-red); }
.boss-when { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: right; }

/* HP bar — enemy health (red), depletes as you study */
.hp { position: relative; }
.hp .track { position: relative; height: 14px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.55); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; }
.hp .track::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border-inner); border-radius: 3px; pointer-events: none; }
.hp .fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--boss-red-glow), var(--boss-red));
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(241, 54, 47, 0.7), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  transition: width 0.45s var(--ease);
}
.hp .lbl { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 10.5px; font-style: normal; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-top: 6px; gap: 8px; }
.hp .lbl .hpv { color: var(--boss-red-glow); text-align: right; }

/* damage float */
.dmg { position: absolute; right: 8px; top: -4px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-size: 18px; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(241, 54, 47, 0.9); pointer-events: none; animation: dmg-rise 0.9s var(--ease) forwards; }
.dmg svg { width: 16px; height: 11px; }
@keyframes dmg-rise { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px) scale(0.8); } 18% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1.1); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-26px) scale(1); } }

/* actions */
.boss-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 13px; }
.btn { font: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; border: none; position: relative; transition: box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease); }
.btn-strike { flex: 1; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); color: var(--text-main); }
.btn-strike::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px; border: 1px solid rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.5); border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; transition: border-color 0.2s var(--ease); }
.btn-strike:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--sheikah-glow); }
.btn-strike:hover::after { border-color: var(--sheikah-blue); }
.btn-strike svg { width: 16px; height: 11px; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px var(--quest-main-glow)); }
.btn-strike.sm { flex: none; padding: 8px 11px; }
.btn-clear { flex: 1; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a14; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFE465, var(--effect-orange)); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.45); }
.btn-clear:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.85); }

/* ready (staggered) state — gold */
.boss.ready::after { border-color: var(--effect-orange); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.4); }
.boss.ready .hp .fill { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFE465, var(--effect-orange)); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.7); }
.stagger { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #1a1a14; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFE465, var(--effect-orange)); padding: 2px 8px 1px; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.7); animation: stagger-pulse 1.1s var(--ease) infinite; }
@keyframes stagger-pulse { 0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.6); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.95); } }

/* cleared (vanquished) state */
.boss.cleared { opacity: 0.82; }
.boss.cleared::after { border-color: rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.5); }
.boss.cleared .boss-actions, .boss.cleared .hp .lbl .hpv { opacity: 0.6; }
.vanquished {
  position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-13deg);
  font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal;
  font-size: clamp(26px, 6vw, 38px);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--effect-orange);
  text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.8);
  border: 3px solid var(--effect-orange);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 4px 18px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 3;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* overdue */
.boss.overdue::after { border-color: rgba(241, 54, 47, 0.7); }

/* ============ Add-boss form ============ */
.add {
  position: relative;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 15px 18px;
  margin-top: 18px;
}
.add::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--border-inner); border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; }
.add h3 { font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; font-size: 15px; color: var(--zelda-tan); letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.add-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.add-row input {
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-inner);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--text-main);
  font: inherit; font-size: 13px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  color-scheme: dark;
}
.add-row .f-name { flex: 1; min-width: 150px; }
.add-row .f-date { flex: none; }
.add-row .f-hrs { flex: none; width: 92px; }
.add-row input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); }
.add-add { flex: none; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a14; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFE465, var(--effect-orange)); border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 18px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.45); }
.add-add:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.8); }

/* ============ Oracle dialog (Dialog capsule) ============ */
.dialog { position: relative; max-width: 820px; margin: 26px auto 6px; padding: 30px 70px 34px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; min-height: 130px; }
.dialog .bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
.dialog .speaker { position: relative; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-main); text-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); margin-bottom: 3px; }
.dialog .content { position: relative; font-size: clamp(14px, 2.1vw, 19px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; }
.dialog .content .hl { color: var(--effect-orange); }
.dialog .content .danger { color: var(--text-red); }

footer { text-align: center; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
footer .ftr-hint { color: var(--text-yellow); letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
footer a { color: var(--sheikah-blue); text-decoration: none; }
footer a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

/* ============ QUEST COMPLETE toast ============ */
.qtoast {
  position: fixed; top: 26px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 60; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.78); border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 22px;
  pointer-events: none; max-width: calc(100vw - 32px);
  animation: toast-in 2.6s var(--ease) forwards;
}
.qtoast[hidden] { display: none; }
.qtoast::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px; border: 1px solid rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.5); border-radius: 2px; }
.qtoast svg { width: 27px; height: 16px; flex: none; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px var(--quest-main-glow)); }
.qtoast .tt { font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: var(--text-yellow); text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 234, 46, 0.5); white-space: nowrap; }
.qtoast .ts { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text-muted); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
@keyframes toast-in { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-8px); } 7%,80% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-6px); } }

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .eye-badge { width: 44px; }
  header { gap: 14px; }
  .hud { gap: 16px; margin-left: 0; }
  .roster { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .dialog { padding: 22px 28px 30px; min-height: 104px; }
  .dialog .speaker { font-size: 14px; }
  .add-row .f-date, .add-row .f-hrs { flex: 1; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .scanlines, .qtoast, .amount.bump, .boss.hit, .dmg, .stagger { animation: none; }
}
</style>

/* ============ Finals Boss Rush logic ============ */
const SWORD = questSvg('main');
const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' }[c]));
const DAY = 864e5, HOUR = 36e5;
const REWARD_PER_HR = 10, REWARD_CLEAR = 100;

/* language: ?lang= > saved > browser */
function pickLang() {
  const u = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('lang');
  if (u === 'zh' || u === 'en') return u;
  try { const s = localStorage.getItem('boss-rush-lang'); if (s === 'zh' || s === 'en') return s; } catch (e) {}
  return (navigator.language || '').toLowerCase().startsWith('zh') ? 'zh' : 'en';
}
let lang = pickLang();
const T = () => I18N[lang];

const epithetFor = name => { const e = T().epithets; return e[[...name].reduce((a, c) => a + c.charCodeAt(0), 0) % e.length]; };
const uid = () => Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6);

const STORE = 'finals-boss-rush-v1';
function seed() {
  const n = Date.now(), atHour = (d, h) => { const x = new Date(n + d * DAY); x.setHours(h, 0, 0, 0); return x.getTime(); };
  const cfg = [[6, 10, 12, 4], [8, 14, 10, 2], [12, 9, 8, 0], [16, 13, 9, 0]];
  return T().seed.map((b, i) => ({ id: uid(), name: b.name, ep: b.ep, exam: atHour(cfg[i][0], cfg[i][1]), max: cfg[i][2], studied: cfg[i][3], cleared: false }));
}
function load() {
  try {
    const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE) || 'null');
    if (Array.isArray(s) && s.every(b => b && typeof b.name === 'string' && typeof b.exam === 'number')) return s;
  } catch (e) {}
  return seed();
}
let bosses = load();
const save = () => { try { localStorage.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify(bosses)); } catch (e) {} };

const hpOf = b => Math.max(0, +(b.max - b.studied).toFixed(2));
const isReady = b => !b.cleared && hpOf(b) <= 0;
const isOverdue = b => !b.cleared && b.exam < Date.now() && hpOf(b) > 0;

function countdown(exam) {
  const diff = exam - Date.now();
  if (diff < 0) return { bare: T().cdPassed, full: T().cdPassed, cls: 'overdue' };
  const d = Math.floor(diff / DAY), h = Math.floor((diff % DAY) / HOUR), m = Math.floor((diff % HOUR) / 60000);
  const bare = T().cdBare(d, h, m);
  return { bare, full: T().cdFull(bare), cls: diff < 2 * DAY ? 'soon' : '' };
}
const fmtWhen = exam => new Date(exam).toLocaleString(T().locale, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

/* ---- HUD + campaign render ---- */
const rupeeEl = document.getElementById('rupee-amount');
function renderHud(bump) {
  const total = bosses.length, cleared = bosses.filter(b => b.cleared).length;
  const sumMax = bosses.reduce((a, b) => a + b.max, 0);
  const sumStud = bosses.reduce((a, b) => a + Math.min(b.studied, b.max), 0);
  const pct = sumMax ? Math.round((sumStud / sumMax) * 100) : 0;

  let hearts = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.max(total, 1); i++) hearts += heartSvg(i < cleared ? 'filled' : 'empty');
  document.getElementById('hearts').innerHTML = hearts;

  document.getElementById('stamina').style.setProperty('--ang', (pct / 100 * 360) + 'deg');
  document.getElementById('stamina').innerHTML = staminaTrack + staminaFill(pct >= 100 ? '#FFE465' : '#13FF59');
  document.getElementById('prep-label').textContent = pct + T().readySuffix;
  document.getElementById('rupee-gem').innerHTML = rupeeSvg();

  const focus = Math.round(sumStud * REWARD_PER_HR + cleared * REWARD_CLEAR);
  rupeeEl.textContent = focus.toLocaleString(T().locale);
  if (bump) { rupeeEl.classList.remove('bump'); void rupeeEl.offsetWidth; rupeeEl.classList.add('bump'); }

  const active = bosses.filter(b => !b.cleared);
  const next = active.filter(b => b.exam >= Date.now()).sort((a, b) => a.exam - b.exam)[0];
  const nextTxt = next ? countdown(next.exam).bare : T().nextNone;
  document.getElementById('campaign').innerHTML = `
    <div class="camp-stat"><span class="n ${cleared === total && total ? 'gold' : 'red'}">${cleared}/${total}</span><span class="l">${T().campVanquished}</span></div>
    <div class="camp-sep"></div>
    <div class="camp-stat"><span class="n">${nextTxt}</span><span class="l">${T().campUntilNext}</span></div>
    <div class="camp-sep"></div>
    <div class="camp-bar">
      <div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:${pct}%"></div></div>
      <div class="cap">${T().campCap(sumStud, sumMax, pct)}</div>
    </div>`;

  const allDown = total > 0 && cleared === total;
  document.getElementById('finale').hidden = !allDown;
  const oracle = document.getElementById('oracle-line');
  if (allDown) oracle.innerHTML = T().oracleAll;
  else if (cleared > 0) oracle.innerHTML = T().oracleMid(cleared);
  else oracle.innerHTML = T().oracleStart;
}

/* ---- roster render ---- */
const roster = document.getElementById('roster');
function bossCard(b) {
  const hp = hpOf(b), pct = b.max ? (hp / b.max) * 100 : 0;
  const ready = isReady(b), overdue = isOverdue(b);
  const cls = ['boss'];
  if (b.cleared) cls.push('cleared');
  else if (ready) cls.push('ready');
  else if (overdue) cls.push('overdue');

  const cd = countdown(b.exam);
  const actions = b.cleared ? ''
    : ready
      ? `<button class="btn btn-clear" data-clear="${b.id}">${T().sitExam}</button>`
      : `<button class="btn btn-strike" data-strike="${b.id}" data-amt="1">${SWORD}${T().study1h}</button>
         <button class="btn btn-strike sm" data-strike="${b.id}" data-amt="0.5" title="${T().plus30Label}" aria-label="${T().plus30Label}">${T().plus30}</button>`;

  return `
    <div class="${cls.join(' ')}" data-id="${b.id}">
      ${b.cleared ? `<span class="vanquished">${T().vanquishedStamp}</span>` : ''}
      <div class="boss-head">
        <div class="boss-name">
          <span class="nm">${esc(b.name)}</span>
          <span class="ep">${esc(b.ep || epithetFor(b.name))}</span>
        </div>
        <button class="boss-del" data-del="${b.id}" aria-label="${esc(T().delLabel(b.name))}">✕</button>
      </div>
      <div class="boss-meta">
        <span class="countdown ${b.cleared ? '' : cd.cls}">${b.cleared ? T().vanquishedCd : (ready ? `<span class="stagger">${T().staggered}</span>` : cd.full)}</span>
        <span class="boss-when">${fmtWhen(b.exam)}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="hp">
        <div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:${pct}%"></div></div>
        <div class="lbl"><span>${T().bossHP}</span><span class="hpv">${ready ? T().hpDown : T().revisionLeft(hp)}</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="boss-actions">${actions}</div>
    </div>`;
}
function renderRoster() {
  const sorted = bosses.slice().sort((a, b) => (a.cleared - b.cleared) || (a.exam - b.exam));
  roster.innerHTML = sorted.length ? sorted.map(bossCard).join('')
    : `<div class="boss" style="grid-column:1/-1"><div class="boss-name"><span class="nm">${T().noBossName}</span><span class="ep">${T().noBossEp}</span></div></div>`;
}
function render(bump) { renderRoster(); renderHud(bump); save(); }

/* ---- static chrome (re-applied on language switch) ---- */
function applyStatic() {
  const t = T();
  document.documentElement.lang = lang;
  document.title = t.docTitle;
  document.getElementById('mast-title').textContent = t.title;
  document.getElementById('mast-sub').innerHTML = `${t.subPlain}<b>${t.subBold}</b>`;
  document.getElementById('lbl-bosses').textContent = t.bossesDown;
  document.getElementById('lbl-focus').textContent = t.focus;
  document.getElementById('finale-h').textContent = t.finaleH;
  document.getElementById('finale-p').textContent = t.finaleP;
  document.getElementById('add-h').textContent = t.addH;
  const fn = document.getElementById('f-name'); fn.placeholder = t.fNamePlaceholder; fn.setAttribute('aria-label', t.fNameLabel);
  document.getElementById('f-date').setAttribute('aria-label', t.fDateLabel);
  document.getElementById('f-hrs').setAttribute('aria-label', t.fHrsLabel);
  document.getElementById('add-btn').textContent = t.summon;
  document.getElementById('oracle-speaker').textContent = t.speaker;
  document.getElementById('footer').innerHTML = `<span class="ftr-hint">${t.footerHint}</span><br/>${t.footerCredit}`;
  document.querySelectorAll('#lang-switch button').forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.lang === lang));
}

/* ---- toast ---- */
const toast = document.getElementById('qtoast');
let toastTimer = null;
function showToast(title, sub) {
  toast.innerHTML = `${SWORD}<span class="tt">${esc(title)}</span><span class="ts">${esc(sub)}</span>`;
  toast.hidden = false;
  toast.style.animation = 'none'; void toast.offsetWidth; toast.style.animation = '';
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(() => { toast.hidden = true; }, 2600);
}

/* ---- damage float ---- */
const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
function floatDamage(cardEl, amt) {
  if (reduceMotion) return;
  const card = cardEl.querySelector('.hp');
  if (!card) return;
  const d = document.createElement('span');
  d.className = 'dmg';
  d.innerHTML = `${SWORD}-${amt}h`;
  card.appendChild(d);
  setTimeout(() => d.remove(), 950);
}

/* ---- actions ---- */
function strike(id, amt) {
  const b = bosses.find(x => x.id === id);
  if (!b || b.cleared) return;
  const before = isReady(b);
  b.studied = Math.min(b.max, +(b.studied + amt).toFixed(2));
  const card = roster.querySelector(`[data-id="${id}"]`);
  if (card && !reduceMotion) { card.classList.remove('hit'); void card.offsetWidth; card.classList.add('hit'); floatDamage(card, amt); }
  render(true);
  if (!before && isReady(b)) showToast(T().toastStagger, T().toastStaggerSub(b.name));
}
function vanquish(id) {
  const b = bosses.find(x => x.id === id);
  if (!b || b.cleared) return;
  b.cleared = true;
  render(true);
  const allDown = bosses.every(x => x.cleared);
  showToast(allDown ? T().toastFinals : T().toastVanquish, T().toastVanquishSub(b.name));
}
function removeBoss(id) { bosses = bosses.filter(b => b.id !== id); render(); }

document.addEventListener('click', ev => {
  const s = ev.target.closest('[data-strike]');
  if (s) { strike(s.dataset.strike, parseFloat(s.dataset.amt)); return; }
  const c = ev.target.closest('[data-clear]');
  if (c) { vanquish(c.dataset.clear); return; }
  const d = ev.target.closest('[data-del]');
  if (d) { removeBoss(d.dataset.del); return; }
  const l = ev.target.closest('[data-lang]');
  if (l) { switchLang(l.dataset.lang); return; }
});

document.getElementById('add-form').addEventListener('submit', ev => {
  ev.preventDefault();
  const name = document.getElementById('f-name').value.trim();
  const dateVal = document.getElementById('f-date').value;
  const hrs = Math.max(1, Math.min(99, parseInt(document.getElementById('f-hrs').value, 10) || 8));
  if (!name || !dateVal) return;
  bosses.push({ id: uid(), name, ep: epithetFor(name), exam: new Date(dateVal).getTime(), max: hrs, studied: 0, cleared: false });
  ev.target.reset();
  document.getElementById('f-hrs').value = 8;
  setDefaultDate();
  render();
  document.getElementById('f-name').focus();
});

function setDefaultDate() {
  const d = new Date(Date.now() + 7 * DAY); d.setHours(10, 0, 0, 0);
  const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  document.getElementById('f-date').value = `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;
}

function switchLang(l) {
  if (l === lang) return;
  lang = l;
  try { localStorage.setItem('boss-rush-lang', l); } catch (e) {}
  applyStatic();
  render(false);
}

applyStatic();
setDefaultDate();
render();
setInterval(() => { renderRoster(); renderHud(false); }, 60000);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />

<meta name="theme-color" content="#0a1628" />
<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="sheikah-eye.svg" />
<meta property="og:type" content="website" />
<meta property="og:site_name" content="zelda-hyrule-ui" />
<meta property="og:title" content="June Quest Calendar · demo" />
<meta property="og:description" content="A Breath of the Wild–style student calendar with an interactive Quest Log. demo, demo, demo skill demo. " />
<meta property="og:url" content="https://chaos-xxl.github.io/zelda-hyrule-ui/showcase/june-quest-calendar.html" />
<meta property="og:image" content="https://chaos-xxl.github.io/zelda-hyrule-ui/showcase/june-quest-calendar-og.png" />
<meta property="og:image:width" content="2400" />
<meta property="og:image:height" content="1260" />
<meta property="og:locale" content="en_US" />
<meta property="og:locale:alternate" content="zh_CN" />
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />
<meta name="twitter:title" content="June Quest Calendar · demo" />
<meta name="twitter:description" content="A BOTW-style student calendar with an interactive Quest Log. demo, demo. " />
<meta name="twitter:image" content="https://chaos-xxl.github.io/zelda-hyrule-ui/showcase/june-quest-calendar-og.png" />
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@400;500;700&family=Roboto:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,700;1,400;1,500;1,700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
<style>
/* ============================================================
   zelda-hyrule-ui style · built strictly from skill/SKILL.md
   Real assets: Hylia Serif (embedded), all SVG paths exported
   from Figma via component sources. No approximations.
   Design: Zelda BOTW UI Kit by Hunter Paramore (CC BY 4.0)
   ============================================================ */

/* — Real Hylia Serif, embedded from the package (dist/files/) — */
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Hylia Serif';
  src: url(data:font/ttf;base64,) format('truetype');
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}

:root {
  /* design tokens — references/design-tokens.md */
  --zelda-dark-bg: #66645D;
  --bg-sheikah-panel: #0a1628;        /* SheikahBackground darkBlue */
  --bg-card: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  --bg-slot: rgba(60, 58, 52, 0.35);
  --text-main: #E9E1D1;
  --text-muted: rgba(233, 225, 209, 0.6);
  --text-yellow: #E2D146;
  --text-red: #F15050;
  --text-green: #6FD49C;
  --zelda-tan: #E2DED3;
  --sheikah-blue: #3CD3FC;
  --sheikah-glow: #4FC0FF;
  --effect-orange: #FCC413;
  --quest-main: #FFD700;
  --quest-main-glow: #FFEA2E;
  --border-inner: rgba(226, 222, 211, 0.3);
  --font-title: 'Hylia Serif', 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif;
  --font-body: 'Roboto', -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

body {
  background: var(--zelda-dark-bg);             /* demo #1 */
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-style: italic;                           /* demo #4 */
  line-height: 1.5;
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: clamp(12px, 3vw, 40px);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

:focus-visible {                                /* demo #8 */
  outline: 2px solid var(--sheikah-blue);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
/* demo (demo #4 demo；demo)  */
html[lang="zh"] body { font-style: normal; }

/* ============ Language switch ============ */
.lang-switch { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px; font-style: normal; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.lang-switch button { font: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-style: normal; color: var(--text-muted); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4); border: 1px solid var(--border-inner); border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 10px; cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: 0.04em; transition: color 0.2s var(--ease), border-color 0.2s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease); }
.lang-switch button:hover { color: var(--text-main); }
.lang-switch button.active { color: var(--sheikah-blue); border-color: var(--sheikah-blue); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.4); }

/* ============ SheikahBackground darkBlue + Scanlines ============ */
.slate {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 1240px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: var(--bg-sheikah-panel);
  border-radius: 8px;                           /* demo 8px */
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}
/* demo — demo (core-patterns.md) */
.slate::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 3px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.4);    /* demo */
  border-radius: 6px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 5;
}
/* demo — demo Figma node 151:4062 (SheikahScanlines demo) */
.scanlines {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  mix-blend-mode: overlay;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    0deg,
    transparent, transparent 1px,
    rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.03) 1px, rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.03) 2px
  );
  filter: blur(0.5px);
  animation: scan-move 8s linear infinite;
  z-index: 4;
}
@keyframes scan-move {
  0%   { background-position: 0 0; }
  100% { background-position: 0 200px; }
}

/* demo — SheikahSymbol demo (demo #3)  */
.eye-watermark {
  position: absolute;
  right: -120px;
  bottom: -140px;
  width: 560px;
  aspect-ratio: 380 / 350;
  --fill-0: #3CD3FC;
  opacity: 0.05;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}

.inner { position: relative; z-index: 1; padding: clamp(20px, 3.5vw, 44px); }

/* ============ Header ============ */
header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 22px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.eye-badge {
  width: 62px;
  aspect-ratio: 380 / 350;
  flex: none;
  --fill-0: var(--sheikah-blue);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(79, 192, 255, 0.6));
}
.masthead h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-style: normal;                           /* demo normal, demo italic */
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 40px);
  color: var(--zelda-tan);
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  line-height: 1.1;
  text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.35);
}
.masthead .sub {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.masthead .sub b { color: var(--sheikah-blue); font-weight: 500; }

/* ============ HUD ============ */
.hud {
  margin-left: auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 26px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  font-style: normal;                           /* HUD demo normal (design-tokens demo) */
}
.hud-group { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.hearts { display: flex; gap: 3px; }
.hearts svg { width: 23px; height: 19px; filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)); }
.stamina-wheel { position: relative; width: 44px; height: 44px; }
.stamina-wheel svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.stamina-wheel .fill {
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(19, 255, 89, 0.6));
  -webkit-mask-image: conic-gradient(from -90deg, black var(--ang), transparent var(--ang));
  mask-image: conic-gradient(from -90deg, black var(--ang), transparent var(--ang));
}
.hud-rupee { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.hud-rupee svg { width: 15px; height: 27px; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.55)); }
.hud-rupee .amount { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 500; color: #FFFDE4; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
.hud .wx svg { width: 24px; height: 26px; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(201, 250, 255, 0.7)); }
.hud-label { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; font-style: italic; }

/* ============ Legend ============ */
.legend {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px 22px;
  margin: 18px 0 20px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border-radius: 4px;
  position: relative;
}
.legend::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 3px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-inner);
  border-radius: 2px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.legend-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); }
.legend-item svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; }
.legend-item b { color: var(--text-main); font-weight: 500; }

/* ============ Calendar grid — demo ============ */
.cal { min-width: 880px; }
.cal-scroll { overflow-x: auto; }
.weekdays {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.weekdays div {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  color: var(--zelda-tan);
  text-align: center;
  padding: 6px 0 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-inner);
}
.weekdays div.wknd { color: var(--text-yellow); }

.grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}
/* demo (ItemBG / core-patterns) */
.cell {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 118px;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 8px 9px 9px;
  transition: box-shadow 0.25s var(--ease);
}
.cell::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 3px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-inner);
  border-radius: 2px;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: border-color 0.25s var(--ease);
}
.cell:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--sheikah-glow); }
.cell:hover::after { border-color: var(--sheikah-blue); }
.cell.empty { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); }
.cell.empty::after { border-color: rgba(226, 222, 211, 0.1); }
.cell.wknd { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }

/* demo — demo (item-slot selected, core-patterns demo)  */
.cell.today {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 7px 3px rgba(246, 231, 152, 0.5),
              0 0 12px 1px rgba(227, 227, 200, 0.8);
}
.cell.today::after { border-color: var(--zelda-tan); }
.today-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: -7px; left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  color: #1a1a14;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFE465, var(--effect-orange));
  padding: 2px 9px 1px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.8);
  z-index: 2;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.dnum {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: 17px;
  color: var(--zelda-tan);
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: 7px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}
.cell.past .dnum, .cell.past .chip { opacity: 0.55; }
.dnum .wx-mini { margin-left: auto; width: 15px; height: 16px; opacity: 0.9; }
.dnum .wx-mini svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }

/* demo chip: demo + demo */
.chip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
  color: var(--text-main);
}
.chip svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; flex: none; margin-top: 1px; }
.chip .t { color: var(--text-muted); font-style: normal; font-size: 10px; }
.chip.main  { color: var(--text-yellow); font-weight: 700; }
.chip.main svg  { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px var(--quest-main-glow)); }
.chip.shrine svg, .chip.side svg { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(84, 192, 253, 0.8)); }
.chip.memory { color: var(--effect-orange); }
.chip.memory svg { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.7)); }
.chip.stamina-wheel svg { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(19, 255, 89, 0.6)); }
.chip.rupee { color: var(--text-green); }

/* ============ Dialog (demo: Dialog demo SVG, demo)  ============ */
.dialog {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 910px;
  margin: 30px auto 6px;
  padding: 34px 76px 40px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 150px;
}
.dialog .bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
.dialog .speaker {
  position: relative;
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-main);
  text-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}
.dialog .content {
  position: relative;
  font-size: clamp(15px, 2.2vw, 21px);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.35;
}
.dialog .content .item { color: #6BDECC; }     /* demo (AI_USAGE demo) */
.dialog .content .danger { color: var(--text-red); }
.dialog .arrow {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 10px; left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  animation: hyrule-blink 1.2s step-end infinite;
}
@keyframes hyrule-blink { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0; } }

footer {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: 18px;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}
footer a { color: var(--sheikah-blue); text-decoration: none; }
footer a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }


/* ============ Agenda view (mobile) ============ */
.agenda { display: none; }
.arow {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 11px 13px;
  margin-bottom: 9px;
}
.arow::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 3px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-inner);
  border-radius: 2px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.arow.wknd { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }
.arow.past { opacity: 0.55; }
.arow.today {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 7px 3px rgba(246, 231, 152, 0.5),
              0 0 12px 1px rgba(227, 227, 200, 0.8);
  margin-top: 14px;
}
.arow.today::after { border-color: var(--zelda-tan); }
.adate { flex: none; width: 50px; text-align: center; }
.adate .n {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: 23px;
  color: var(--zelda-tan);
  line-height: 1;
}
.adate .w {
  display: block;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-style: normal;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: 3px;
}
.arow.wknd .adate .w { color: var(--text-yellow); }
.adate .wx-mini { display: block; width: 14px; height: 15px; margin: 5px auto 0; opacity: 0.9; }
.adate .wx-mini svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.achips { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding-top: 3px; }
.achips .chip:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.achips .none { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); }

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .cal-scroll { display: none; }
  .agenda { display: block; }
  .eye-badge { width: 44px; }
  header { gap: 14px; }
  .hud { gap: 18px; margin-left: 0; }
  .legend { flex-wrap: nowrap; overflow-x: auto; gap: 18px; scrollbar-width: none; }
  .legend::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .legend-item { white-space: nowrap; }
  .dialog { padding: 22px 30px 34px; min-height: 110px; margin-top: 20px; }
  .dialog .speaker { font-size: 15px; }
  .dialog .content { font-size: 13.5px; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .scanlines, .dialog .arrow { animation: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .hud { margin-left: 0; }
  .dialog { padding: 28px 40px 36px; }
}

/* ============ Interactive layer: Quest Log modal / toast / rewards ============ */
.cell[data-day], .arow[data-day] { cursor: pointer; }
.chip.done > span { text-decoration: line-through; opacity: 0.5; }
.chip.done svg { opacity: 0.4; filter: none !important; }
footer .ftr-hint { color: var(--text-yellow); letter-spacing: 0.06em; }

.qmodal { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 50; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 18px; }
.qmodal[hidden] { display: none; }
.qmodal-mask { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65); backdrop-filter: blur(3px); }
.qmodal-panel {
  position: relative;
  width: min(560px, 100%);
  max-height: min(84vh, 660px);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--bg-sheikah-panel);
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 18px rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.25);
  overflow: hidden;
}
/* demo (demo) — demo .slate demo */
.qmodal-panel::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 3px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.4);
  border-radius: 6px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 3;
}
.qm-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 18px 20px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-inner); }
.qm-date { flex: none; text-align: center; }
.qm-num { display: block; font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-size: 34px; color: var(--zelda-tan); line-height: 1; }
.qm-wd { display: block; font-size: 9px; font-style: normal; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 3px; }
.qm-head h2 {
  flex: 1;
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: 20px;
  color: var(--zelda-tan);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.35);
}
.qm-wx { width: 22px; height: 24px; flex: none; }
.qm-wx svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(201, 250, 255, 0.7)); }
.qm-close { background: none; border: none; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 17px; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 4px; font-style: normal; }
.qm-close:hover { color: var(--sheikah-blue); }

.qm-list { padding: 14px 20px 6px; overflow-y: auto; flex: 1; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: rgba(60,211,252,0.35) transparent; }
.qm-none { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 4px 2px 12px; }
.qm-quest {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: box-shadow 0.25s var(--ease);
}
.qm-quest::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 3px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-inner);
  border-radius: 2px;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: border-color 0.25s var(--ease);
}
.qm-quest:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--sheikah-glow); }
.qm-quest:hover::after { border-color: var(--sheikah-blue); }
.qm-quest > svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; }
.qm-quest .t { color: var(--text-muted); font-style: normal; font-size: 11px; margin-right: 6px; }
.qm-quest .txt { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.qm-quest.main .txt { color: var(--text-yellow); font-weight: 700; }
.qm-quest.memory .txt { color: var(--effect-orange); }
.qm-quest.rupee .txt { color: var(--text-green); }
.qm-quest .st { flex: none; font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--text-muted); }
.qm-quest.done .st { color: var(--effect-orange); text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.6); }
.qm-quest.done .txt { text-decoration: line-through; opacity: 0.5; }
.qm-quest.done > svg { opacity: 0.4; }
.qm-del { flex: none; background: none; border: none; color: var(--text-muted); font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-style: normal; cursor: pointer; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 3px; }
.qm-del:hover { color: var(--text-red); }

.qm-form { padding: 4px 20px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-inner); }
.qm-kinds { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin: 12px 0 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.qm-kind { position: relative; }
.qm-kind input { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.qm-kind span {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
  font-size: 10.5px; font-style: normal;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  background: var(--bg-card);
  padding: 5px 9px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  transition: border-color 0.2s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease);
}
.qm-kind svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
.qm-kind input:checked + span { border-color: var(--sheikah-blue); color: var(--text-main); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(79, 192, 255, 0.45); }
.qm-kind input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid var(--sheikah-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }
.qm-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.qm-row input {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-inner);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--text-main);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 13px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  color-scheme: dark;
}
.qm-row input[type="time"] { flex: none; width: 100px; }
.qm-row input[type="text"] { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.qm-row input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); }
/* demo — demo today-badge demo (effect-orange demo)  */
.qm-add {
  flex: none;
  font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; font-style: italic;
  color: #1a1a14;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFE465, var(--effect-orange));
  border: none;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.45);
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease);
}
.qm-add:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.8); }
.qm-hint { padding: 0 20px 16px; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--text-muted); }

/* QUEST COMPLETE toast (QuestNotification demo: demo + demo)  */
.qtoast {
  position: fixed;
  top: 26px; left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 60;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.78);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 10px 22px;
  pointer-events: none;
  max-width: calc(100vw - 32px);
  animation: toast-in 2.3s var(--ease) forwards;
}
.qtoast[hidden] { display: none; }
.qtoast::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px; border: 1px solid rgba(252, 196, 19, 0.5); border-radius: 2px; }
.qtoast svg { width: 27px; height: 16px; flex: none; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px var(--quest-main-glow)); }
.qtoast .tt { font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: var(--text-yellow); text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 234, 46, 0.5); white-space: nowrap; }
.qtoast .ts { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text-muted); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
@keyframes toast-in {
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-8px); }
  8%, 82% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-6px); }
}
.hud .amount { display: inline-block; }
.amount.bump { animation: rupee-bump 0.45s var(--ease); }
@keyframes rupee-bump {
  0% { transform: scale(1); }
  35% { transform: scale(1.25); color: #FFE465; }
  100% { transform: scale(1); }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .qmodal { padding: 0; align-items: flex-end; }
  .qmodal-panel { width: 100%; max-height: 86vh; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; }
  .qm-row input[type="time"] { width: 86px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .qtoast { animation: none; }
  .amount.bump { animation: none; }
}

</style>
</head>

    },
