};

function pickLang() {
  const u = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('lang');
  if (u === 'zh' || u === 'en') return u;
  try { const s = localStorage.getItem('calendar-lang'); if (s === 'zh' || s === 'en') return s; } catch (e) {}
  return (navigator.language || '').toLowerCase().startsWith('zh') ? 'zh' : 'en';
}
let lang = pickLang();
const T = () => I18N[lang];

/* ============ Schedule constants ============ */
const TODAY = 11;
const forecast = { 8: 'cloudy', 9: 'clear', 10: 'rain', 11: 'clear', 12: 'clear', 13: 'storm', 14: 'cloudy' };
const DAYS = 30, FIRST_WD = 1; /* June 1 2026 = Monday */
const weekdayOf = d => ((FIRST_WD - 1 + d - 1) % 7) + 1;
const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' }[c]));
const legendOrder = ['main', 'side', 'shrine', 'memory', 'stamina', 'rupee'];

/* — persisted state (custom quests + completions; user data, never translated) — */
const STORE_KEY = 'june-quest-calendar-v2';
let state = { custom: {}, done: [] };
try {
  const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY) || 'null');
  if (s && s.custom && typeof s.custom === 'object' && Array.isArray(s.done)) state = s;
} catch (e) { /* corrupted storage -> start fresh */ }
const save = () => { try { localStorage.setItem(STORE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); } catch (e) { /* private mode */ } };
const isDone = id => state.done.includes(id);
const REWARD = { main: 50, shrine: 30, side: 10, memory: 10, stamina: 10, rupee: 10 };

/* merge built-in schedule (per language) + custom quests for one day, stable ids */
function dayEvents(d) {
  let events = (T().recurring[weekdayOf(d)] || []).map((e, i) => ({ ...e, id: d + ':r' + i }));
  const o = T().oneoff[d];
  if (o) { if (o.replace) events = []; events = events.concat(o.add.map((e, i) => ({ ...e, id: d + ':o' + i }))); }
  events = events.concat((state.custom[d] || []).map(e => ({ ...e, custom: true })));
  events.sort((a, b) => (a.t || '99').localeCompare(b.t || '99'));
  return events;
}

/* — HUD rupees = base + quest rewards — */
const RUPEE_BASE = 1240;
const rupeeEl = document.getElementById('rupee-amount');
function renderRupees(bump) {
  let sum = 0;
  for (let d = 1; d <= DAYS; d++) for (const e of dayEvents(d)) if (isDone(e.id)) sum += REWARD[e.k] || 10;
  rupeeEl.textContent = (RUPEE_BASE + sum).toLocaleString(T().rupeeLocale);
  if (bump) { rupeeEl.classList.remove('bump'); void rupeeEl.offsetWidth; rupeeEl.classList.add('bump'); }
}

/* ============ Grid + agenda render ============ */
const grid = document.getElementById('grid');
const agendaEl = document.getElementById('agenda');
const chipHtml = e =>
  `<div class="chip ${e.k}${isDone(e.id) ? ' done' : ''}">${ICON[e.k]}<span>${e.t ? `<span class="t">${esc(e.t)}</span> ` : ''}${esc(e.s)}</span></div>`;

function render() {
  let html = '', agendaHtml = '';
  for (let d = 1; d <= DAYS; d++) {
    const wd = weekdayOf(d);
    const events = dayEvents(d);
    const wx = forecast[d] ? `<span class="wx-mini" title="${forecast[d]}">${wxSvg(forecast[d])}</span>` : '';
    const badge = d === TODAY ? `<span class="today-badge">${T().today}</span>` : '';
    const chips = events.map(chipHtml).join('');
    const aria = T().ariaOpen(d, events.length);
    const attrs = ` role="button" tabindex="0" data-day="${d}" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-label="${esc(aria)}"${d === TODAY ? ' aria-current="date"' : ''}`;
    const cls = ['cell'];
    if (wd >= 6) cls.push('wknd');
    if (d === TODAY) cls.push('today');
    if (d < TODAY) cls.push('past');
    html += `<div class="${cls.join(' ')}"${attrs}>${badge}<div class="dnum">${d}${wx}</div>${chips}</div>`;

    const acls = ['arow'];
    if (wd >= 6) acls.push('wknd');
    if (d === TODAY) acls.push('today');
    if (d < TODAY) acls.push('past');
    agendaHtml += `<div class="${acls.join(' ')}"${attrs}>${badge}<div class="adate"><span class="n">${d}</span><span class="w">${T().wd[wd]}</span>${wx}</div><div class="achips">${chips || `<span class="none">${T().agendaNone}</span>`}</div></div>`;
  }
  /* trailing empties to square off week 5 */
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) html += '<div class="cell empty" aria-hidden="true"></div>';
  grid.innerHTML = html;
  agendaEl.innerHTML = agendaHtml;
}

/* ============ Quest Log modal ============ */
const modal = document.getElementById('qmodal');
const qmList = document.getElementById('qm-list');
let openDayNum = null, lastFocus = null;

function renderModalList() {
  const events = dayEvents(openDayNum);
  qmList.innerHTML = events.length ? events.map(e => `
    <div class="qm-quest ${e.k}${isDone(e.id) ? ' done' : ''}" role="button" tabindex="0" data-id="${e.id}" aria-pressed="${isDone(e.id)}" aria-label="${isDone(e.id) ? esc(T().completedPrefix) : ''}${esc(e.s)}">
      ${ICON[e.k]}
      <span class="txt">${e.t ? `<span class="t">${esc(e.t)}</span>` : ''}${esc(e.s)}</span>
      ${e.custom ? `<button type="button" class="qm-del" data-del="${e.id}" aria-label="${esc(T().delLabel(e.s))}">✕</button>` : ''}
      <span class="st">${isDone(e.id) ? T().statusCleared : T().statusOpen}</span>
    </div>`).join('')
    : `<div class="qm-none">${T().none}</div>`;
}

function openDay(d) {
  openDayNum = d;
  lastFocus = document.activeElement;
  document.getElementById('qm-num').textContent = d;
  document.getElementById('qm-wd').textContent = T().wd[weekdayOf(d)];
  document.getElementById('qm-wx').innerHTML = forecast[d] ? wxSvg(forecast[d]) : '';
  renderModalList();
  modal.hidden = false;
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  document.querySelector('.qm-close').focus();
}
function closeModal() {
  modal.hidden = true;
  openDayNum = null;
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
  if (lastFocus && lastFocus.focus) lastFocus.focus();
}

/* — QUEST COMPLETE toast (QuestNotification semantics) — */
const toast = document.getElementById('qtoast');
let toastTimer = null;
function showToast(kind, text) {
  toast.innerHTML = `${ICON[kind]}<span class="tt">${esc(T().questComplete)}</span><span class="ts">${esc(text)}</span>`;
  toast.hidden = false;
  toast.style.animation = 'none'; void toast.offsetWidth; toast.style.animation = '';
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(() => { toast.hidden = true; }, 2300);
}

function toggleDone(id) {
  const i = state.done.indexOf(id);
  const completing = i < 0;
  if (completing) state.done.push(id); else state.done.splice(i, 1);
  save();
  render();
  if (openDayNum != null) renderModalList();
  renderRupees(completing);
  if (completing && openDayNum != null) {
    const e = dayEvents(openDayNum).find(x => x.id === id);
    if (e) showToast(e.k, T().rewardText(e.s, REWARD[e.k] || 10));
  }
}

/* ============ static chrome (re-applied on language switch) ============ */
function applyStatic() {
  const t = T();
  document.documentElement.lang = lang;
  document.title = t.docTitle;
  document.getElementById('cal-title').textContent = t.title;
  document.getElementById('cal-sub').innerHTML = t.subHtml;
  document.getElementById('legend').innerHTML = legendOrder.map(k =>
    `<span class="legend-item">${ICON[k]}<b>${t.legend[k].label}</b> ${t.legend[k].desc}</span>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('weekdays').innerHTML = t.weekdays.map((w, i) =>
    `<div${i >= 5 ? ' class="wknd"' : ''}>${w}</div>`).join('');
  const groups = document.querySelectorAll('.hud .hud-group');
  t.hudTitles.forEach((title, i) => { if (groups[i]) groups[i].title = title; });
  const hud = document.querySelector('.hud');
  if (hud) hud.setAttribute('aria-label', t.hudAria);
  document.getElementById('oracle-speaker').textContent = t.oracleSpeaker;
  document.getElementById('oracle-line').innerHTML = t.oracleHtml;
  document.getElementById('footer').innerHTML = `<span class="ftr-hint">${t.footerHint}</span><br/>${t.footerCredit}`;
  document.getElementById('qm-title').textContent = t.modalTitle;
  document.getElementById('qm-kinds').setAttribute('aria-label', t.questType);
  document.getElementById('qm-kinds').innerHTML = legendOrder.map(k =>
    `<label class="qm-kind"><input type="radio" name="qk" value="${k}"${k === 'side' ? ' checked' : ''} /><span>${ICON[k]}${t.kinds[k]}</span></label>`).join('');
  const tx = document.getElementById('qm-text'); tx.placeholder = t.placeholder; tx.setAttribute('aria-label', t.titleLabel);
  document.getElementById('qm-time').setAttribute('aria-label', t.timeLabel);
  document.getElementById('qm-close').setAttribute('aria-label', t.closeLabel);
  document.getElementById('qm-add').textContent = t.accept;
  document.getElementById('qm-hint').innerHTML = t.hint;
  document.querySelectorAll('#lang-switch button').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.lang === lang));
}

function switchLang(l) {
  if (l === lang) return;
  lang = l;
  try { localStorage.setItem('calendar-lang', l); } catch (e) {}
  applyStatic();
  render();
  if (openDayNum != null) renderModalList();
}

/* — event wiring (delegation) — */
document.addEventListener('click', ev => {
  const ls = ev.target.closest('[data-lang]');
  if (ls) { switchLang(ls.dataset.lang); return; }
  const del = ev.target.closest('[data-del]');
  if (del) {
    const id = del.dataset.del, d = openDayNum;
    state.custom[d] = (state.custom[d] || []).filter(e => e.id !== id);
    if (!state.custom[d].length) delete state.custom[d];
    const di = state.done.indexOf(id);
    if (di >= 0) state.done.splice(di, 1);
    save(); render(); renderModalList(); renderRupees();
    return;
  }
  const q = ev.target.closest('.qm-quest');
  if (q) { toggleDone(q.dataset.id); return; }
  if (ev.target.closest('[data-close]')) { closeModal(); return; }
  const day = ev.target.closest('[data-day]');
  if (day) openDay(+day.dataset.day);
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', ev => {
  if (ev.key === 'Escape' && !modal.hidden) { closeModal(); return; }
  if (ev.key !== 'Enter' && ev.key !== ' ') return;
  const tg = ev.target;
  if (!tg || !tg.matches) return;
  if (tg.matches('.qm-quest')) { ev.preventDefault(); toggleDone(tg.dataset.id); }
  else if (tg.matches('[data-day]')) { ev.preventDefault(); openDay(+tg.dataset.day); }
});

/* light focus trap inside the modal */
modal.addEventListener('keydown', ev => {
  if (ev.key !== 'Tab') return;
  const items = modal.querySelectorAll('button, input, [tabindex="0"]');
  if (!items.length) return;
  const first = items[0], last = items[items.length - 1];
  if (ev.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { ev.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
  else if (!ev.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { ev.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
});

/* add-quest form */
document.getElementById('qm-form').addEventListener('submit', ev => {
  ev.preventDefault();
  if (openDayNum == null) return;
  const textEl = document.getElementById('qm-text');
  const s = textEl.value.trim();
  if (!s) return;
  const k = document.querySelector('#qm-kinds input:checked').value;
  const t = document.getElementById('qm-time').value;
  (state.custom[openDayNum] = state.custom[openDayNum] || []).push({ id: openDayNum + ':c' + Date.now(), k, t, s });
  save();
  textEl.value = '';
  document.getElementById('qm-time').value = '';
  render(); renderModalList(); renderRupees();
  textEl.focus();
});

applyStatic();
render();
renderRupees();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<style>
/* ============================================================
   zelda-hyrule-ui style · built strictly from skill/SKILL.md
   Real assets (Hylia Serif + all SVG paths) reused verbatim from
   the showcase calendar's package-exported sources. No approximations.
   Bilingual (EN / demo) — single source, switch top-right or ?lang=zh.
   Design: Zelda BOTW UI Kit by Hunter Paramore (CC BY 4.0)
   ============================================================ */

@font-face {
  font-family: 'Hylia Serif';
  src: url(data:font/ttf;base64,) format('truetype');
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}

:root {
  --zelda-dark-bg: #66645D;
  --bg-sheikah-panel: #0a1628;
  --bg-card: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  --text-main: #E9E1D1;
  --text-muted: rgba(233, 225, 209, 0.6);
  --text-yellow: #E2D146;
  --zelda-tan: #E2DED3;
  --sheikah-blue: #3CD3FC;
  --sheikah-glow: #4FC0FF;
  --effect-orange: #FCC413;
  --heart-red: #F1362F;
  --focus-green: #13FF59;
  --rest-blue: #3CD3FC;

  --low-red: #F15050;
  --border-inner: rgba(226, 222, 211, 0.3);
  --font-title: 'Hylia Serif', 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif;
  --font-body: 'Roboto', -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

body {
  background: var(--zelda-dark-bg);
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.5;
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: clamp(12px, 3vw, 40px);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sheikah-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }
html[lang="zh"] body { font-style: normal; }

/* ============ SheikahBackground darkBlue + Scanlines ============ */
.slate {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: var(--bg-sheikah-panel);
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}
.slate::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 3px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.4);
  border-radius: 6px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 5;
}
.scanlines {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  mix-blend-mode: overlay;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 1px, rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.03) 1px, rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.03) 2px);
  filter: blur(0.5px);
  animation: scan-move 8s linear infinite;
  z-index: 4;
}
@keyframes scan-move { 0% { background-position: 0 0; } 100% { background-position: 0 200px; } }

.eye-watermark {
  position: absolute;
  right: -140px; bottom: -160px;
  width: 520px;
  aspect-ratio: 380 / 350;
  --fill-0: #3CD3FC;
  opacity: 0.05;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}
.inner { position: relative; z-index: 1; padding: clamp(20px, 3.5vw, 40px); }

/* ============ Language switch ============ */
.lang-switch { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px; font-style: normal; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.lang-switch button { font: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-style: normal; color: var(--text-muted); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4); border: 1px solid var(--border-inner); border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 10px; cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: 0.04em; transition: color 0.2s var(--ease), border-color 0.2s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease); }
.lang-switch button:hover { color: var(--text-main); }
.lang-switch button.active { color: var(--sheikah-blue); border-color: var(--sheikah-blue); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.4); }

/* ============ Header ============ */
header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 22px; }
.eye-badge { width: 54px; aspect-ratio: 380 / 350; flex: none; --fill-0: var(--sheikah-blue); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(79, 192, 255, 0.6)); }
.masthead h1 { font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(24px, 4vw, 34px); color: var(--zelda-tan); letter-spacing: 0.04em; line-height: 1.1; text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(60, 211, 252, 0.35); }
.masthead .sub { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.06em; margin-top: 4px; }
.masthead .sub b { color: var(--sheikah-blue); font-weight: 500; font-style: normal; }

/* ============ HUD (today stats) ============ */
.hud { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-style: normal; }
.hud-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; }
.hud-group .v { font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-size: 20px; color: var(--zelda-tan); line-height: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.hud-group .v svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(79,192,255,0.7)); }
.hud-label { font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; }

/* ============ Timer ============ */
.timer { text-align: center; }
.ring-wrap { position: relative; width: clamp(210px, 42vw, 268px); aspect-ratio: 1; margin: 6px auto 0; }
.ring-wrap svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.ring-wrap .fill {
  -webkit-mask-image: conic-gradient(from -90deg, black var(--ang), transparent var(--ang));
  mask-image: conic-gradient(from -90deg, black var(--ang), transparent var(--ang));
  transition: filter 0.3s var(--ease);
}
.ring-wrap.running .fill { animation: ring-pulse 2.4s var(--ease) infinite; }
@keyframes ring-pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.78; } }
.ring-center { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; }
.ring-center::before { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 60%; height: 60%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--bg-sheikah-panel) 58%, rgba(10,22,40,0) 100%); }
.time, .phase { position: relative; }
.time { font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-size: clamp(34px, 7vw, 46px); color: var(--zelda-tan); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); }
.phase { font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.28em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.phase.focus { color: var(--focus-green); }
.phase.rest { color: var(--rest-blue); }
.phase.long { color: var(--long-gold); }

.task { margin: 18px auto 0; max-width: 360px; }
.task input { width: 100%; text-align: center; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.45); border: 1px solid var(--border-inner); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--text-main); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; padding: 9px 12px; }
.task input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); }

.controls { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.btn { font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 4px; border: none; position: relative; transition: box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease); }
.btn-main { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 132px; padding: 11px 22px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); color: var(--text-main); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
.btn-main::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px; border: 1px solid rgba(60,211,252,0.5); border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; transition: border-color 0.2s var(--ease); }
.btn-main:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--sheikah-glow); }
.btn-main:hover::after { border-color: var(--sheikah-blue); }
.btn-main.go::after { border-color: var(--focus-green); }
.btn-main.go:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(19,255,89,0.6); }
.btn-ghost { background: none; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 11px 14px; font-style: normal; }
.btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--text-main); }

/* presets */
.presets { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.preset { position: relative; }
.preset input { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.preset span { display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-style: normal; color: var(--text-muted); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: border-color 0.2s var(--ease), color 0.2s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease); }
.preset input:checked + span { border-color: var(--sheikah-blue); color: var(--text-main); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(79,192,255,0.4); }
.preset input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid var(--sheikah-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* today progress: orbs → heart */
.progress { position: relative; max-width: 420px; margin: 22px auto 0; background: var(--bg-card); border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 16px; }
.progress::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--border-inner); border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; }
.progress .row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; }
.progress .hearts { display: flex; gap: 3px; }
.progress .hearts svg { width: 18px; height: 14px; filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)); }
.progress .dots { display: flex; gap: 5px; }
.progress .dot { width: 11px; height: 11px; }
.progress .dot svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; opacity: 0.28; }
.progress .dot.on svg { opacity: 1; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(79,192,255,0.8)); }
.progress .cap { text-align: center; font-size: 10.5px; font-style: normal; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-top: 7px; }

/* ============ Oracle dialog ============ */
.dialog { position: relative; max-width: 680px; margin: 24px auto 4px; padding: 28px 64px 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; min-height: 120px; }
.dialog .bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
.dialog .speaker { position: relative; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-main); text-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); margin-bottom: 3px; }
.dialog .content { position: relative; font-size: clamp(13px, 2vw, 18px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; }
.dialog .content .hl { color: var(--effect-orange); }

footer { text-align: center; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
footer .ftr-hint { color: var(--text-yellow); letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
footer a { color: var(--sheikah-blue); text-decoration: none; }
footer a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

/* ============ toast ============ */
.qtoast { position: fixed; top: 26px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 60; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.78); border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 22px; pointer-events: none; max-width: calc(100vw - 32px); animation: toast-in 2.6s var(--ease) forwards; }
.qtoast[hidden] { display: none; }
.qtoast::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--tc, rgba(60,211,252,0.5)); border-radius: 2px; }
.qtoast svg { width: 22px; height: 18px; flex: none; }
.qtoast .tt { font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: normal; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: var(--tt, var(--sheikah-blue)); text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(60,211,252,0.4); white-space: nowrap; }
.qtoast .ts { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text-muted); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
@keyframes toast-in { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-8px); } 7%,80% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-6px); } }

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .eye-badge { width: 42px; }
  header { gap: 12px; }
  .hud { gap: 14px; margin-left: 0; width: 100%; justify-content: flex-start; }
  .dialog { padding: 22px 28px 28px; min-height: 100px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .scanlines, .qtoast, .ring-wrap.running .fill { animation: none; }
}
</style>

const dur = m => (m === 'focus' ? PRESETS[presetIdx].f : m === 'rest' ? PRESETS[presetIdx].r : PRESETS[presetIdx].l) * 60;
const heartsToday = () => Math.floor(today.sessions / SESSIONS_PER_HEART);
const MODE_COLOR = { focus: '#13FF59', rest: '#3CD3FC', long: '#FCC413' };

/* ---- audio cue (optional, silent on failure) ---- */
let audioCtx = null;
function beep(freq) {
  try {
    audioCtx = audioCtx || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const o = audioCtx.createOscillator(), g = audioCtx.createGain();
    o.type = 'sine'; o.frequency.value = freq;
    o.connect(g); g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, audioCtx.currentTime);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.02);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
    o.start(); o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
  } catch (e) {}
}

/* ---- render ---- */
const fmt = s => `${String(Math.floor(s / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
function renderTimer() {
  const total = dur(mode), ratio = Math.max(0, remaining / total);
  document.getElementById('ring').style.setProperty('--ang', (ratio * 360) + 'deg');
  let color = MODE_COLOR[mode];
  if (mode === 'focus' && ratio <= 0.2) color = '#F15050';
  const fillPath = document.getElementById('fill-path');
  fillPath.setAttribute('fill', color);
  document.getElementById('fill-svg').style.filter = `drop-shadow(0 0 5px ${color})`;
  document.getElementById('time').textContent = fmt(remaining);
  const ph = document.getElementById('phase');
  ph.className = 'phase ' + mode;
  ph.textContent = mode === 'focus' ? T().phaseFocus : mode === 'rest' ? T().phaseRest : T().phaseLong;
  document.getElementById('ring').classList.toggle('running', running);
  const main = document.getElementById('btn-main');
  main.textContent = running ? T().pause : (remaining < total ? T().resume : T().start);
  main.classList.toggle('go', !running);
}
function renderStats(bump) {
  document.getElementById('hud-orb').innerHTML = ORB;
  document.getElementById('stat-sessions').textContent = today.sessions;
  document.getElementById('stat-minutes').textContent = Math.round(today.focusSec / 60);
  document.getElementById('stat-streak').textContent = sessionStreak;

  const into = today.sessions % SESSIONS_PER_HEART, hearts = heartsToday();
  let heartsHtml = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(hearts, 8); i++) heartsHtml += heartSvg('filled');
  let dots = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < SESSIONS_PER_HEART; i++) dots += `<span class="dot ${i < into ? 'on' : ''}">${ORB}</span>`;
  document.getElementById('progress').innerHTML = `
    <div class="row">${heartsHtml ? `<span class="hearts">${heartsHtml}</span>` : ''}<span class="dots">${dots}</span></div>
    <div class="cap">${T().progressCap(into, SESSIONS_PER_HEART, hearts)}</div>`;
}
function renderOracle() {
  const o = document.getElementById('oracle-line');
  if (mode === 'focus') o.innerHTML = running ? T().oracleFocus(document.getElementById('task-input').value.trim()) : T().oracleIdle;
  else o.innerHTML = mode === 'long' ? T().oracleLong : T().oracleRest;
}
function render(bump) { renderTimer(); renderStats(bump); renderOracle(); save(); }

/* ---- toast ---- */
const toast = document.getElementById('qtoast');
let toastTimer = null;
function showToast(title, sub, color, icon) {
  toast.style.setProperty('--tc', color);
  toast.innerHTML = `${icon || ORB}<span class="tt" style="color:${color}">${esc(title)}</span><span class="ts">${esc(sub)}</span>`;
  toast.hidden = false;
  toast.style.animation = 'none'; void toast.offsetWidth; toast.style.animation = '';
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(() => { toast.hidden = true; }, 2600);
}

/* ---- core ---- */
function tick() {
  remaining--;
  if (remaining <= 0) { completePhase(); return; }
  renderTimer();
}
function completePhase() {
  const wasFocus = mode === 'focus';
  if (wasFocus) {
    const before = heartsToday();
    today.sessions++; today.focusSec += dur('focus'); sessionStreak++;
    beep(660);
    mode = (today.sessions % SESSIONS_PER_HEART === 0) ? 'long' : 'rest';
    remaining = dur(mode);
    render();
    showToast(T().focusDone, T().focusDoneSub, '#13FF59', ORB);
    if (heartsToday() > before) setTimeout(() => showToast(T().heartGet, T().heartGetSub(heartsToday()), '#FF8A80', heartSvg('filled')), 700);
    /* auto-start the break */
  } else {
    beep(440);
    mode = 'focus'; remaining = dur('focus'); running = false;
    if (ticker) { clearInterval(ticker); ticker = null; }
    render();
    showToast(T().breakOver, T().breakOverSub, '#3CD3FC', ORB);
  }
}
function setRunning(on) {
  running = on;
  if (ticker) { clearInterval(ticker); ticker = null; }
  if (running) { if (!audioCtx) beep(0); ticker = setInterval(tick, 1000); }
  renderTimer(); renderOracle();
}
function resetTimer() { setRunning(false); remaining = dur(mode); render(); }
function skipPhase() {
  setRunning(false);
  mode = mode === 'focus' ? 'rest' : 'focus';
  remaining = dur(mode);
  render();
}

/* ---- static chrome ---- */
function applyStatic() {
  const t = T();
  document.documentElement.lang = lang;
  document.title = t.docTitle;
  document.getElementById('mast-title').textContent = t.title;
  document.getElementById('mast-sub').innerHTML = `${t.subPlain}<b>${t.subBold}</b>`;
  document.getElementById('lbl-sessions').textContent = t.sessions;
  document.getElementById('lbl-minutes').textContent = t.minutes;
  document.getElementById('lbl-streak').textContent = t.streak;
  document.getElementById('btn-reset').textContent = t.reset;
  document.getElementById('btn-skip').textContent = t.skip;
  const ti = document.getElementById('task-input'); ti.placeholder = t.taskPlaceholder; ti.setAttribute('aria-label', t.taskLabel);
  document.getElementById('presets').innerHTML = PRESETS.map((p, i) =>
    `<label class="preset"><input type="radio" name="preset" value="${i}"${i === presetIdx ? ' checked' : ''} /><span>${t.presets[p.id]}</span></label>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('oracle-speaker').textContent = t.speaker;
  document.getElementById('footer').innerHTML = `<span class="ftr-hint">${t.footerHint}</span><br/>${t.footerCredit}`;
  document.querySelectorAll('#lang-switch button').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.lang === lang));
}
function switchLang(l) {
  if (l === lang) return;
  lang = l;
  try { localStorage.setItem('focus-timer-lang', l); } catch (e) {}
  applyStatic();
  render();
}

/* ---- wiring ---- */
document.getElementById('btn-main').addEventListener('click', () => setRunning(!running));
document.getElementById('btn-reset').addEventListener('click', resetTimer);
document.getElementById('btn-skip').addEventListener('click', skipPhase);
document.getElementById('task-input').addEventListener('input', renderOracle);
document.addEventListener('click', ev => {
  const ls = ev.target.closest('[data-lang]');
  if (ls) switchLang(ls.dataset.lang);
});
document.getElementById('presets').addEventListener('change', ev => {
  const i = +ev.target.value;
  if (Number.isNaN(i)) return;
  presetIdx = i;
  resetTimer();
});
/* space toggles start/pause (unless typing) */
document.addEventListener('keydown', ev => {
  if (ev.key === ' ' && ev.target.tagName !== 'INPUT') { ev.preventDefault(); setRunning(!running); }
});

applyStatic();
render();
</script>
